assumptions.liquid_properties_basis: Rounded estimates near 300 K; blend viscosity/density informed by Gonzalez 2007; no exact data fit claimed
assumptions.air_demand: Module 03 fresh charge scaled by 500 cc / source displacement, rpm and manifold pressure ratio; constant trapped-temperature/VE proxy
assumptions.metering: Quasi-steady rectangular intake pulses; atmosphere-vented bowls; main at throat, idle downstream of throttle
assumptions.idle_progression: Idle effective port area tapers linearly to zero at 700 Pa venturi signal; empirical layout assumption requiring bench calibration
assumptions.throttle: Map coordinate is manifold pressure ratio, not butterfly angle; no throttle-angle torque model
assumptions.heat_model: Frozen NASA7 enthalpy from source mechanism; 300 K liquids; additive pure-component vaporization; no water fuel energy
assumptions.viscosity: Quadratic orifice pressure drop plus laminar bore loss; Cd_inviscid 0.75; effective Cd is reported
assumptions.drill_sizes: Rounded to 0.01 mm; geometric diameters, not commercial jet-number labels
assumptions.execution: Serial deterministic algebraic sizing; no benefit from multiprocessing

heat_balance.basis: 2000 rpm WOT; fresh exhaust mass; frozen EVO composition; no condensation credit
heat_balance.effectiveness_definition: 0.6 times hot-side sensible availability down to 360 K; screening heat-recovery factor, not a solved two-stream HX

module03_compatible.description: Energy budget for Module 03 idealization: air and methanol vapour initially at 360 K, water at 300 K; subsequent mixing cools the charge. Not a selective vaporization prediction for the premix

limitations: EVO temperature is an optimistic HX inlet proxy; exhaust blowdown and pipe losses are not resolved.
Full vaporization at 360 K changes trapped density and the Module 03 cycle; rerun Module 03 for that configuration.
Heat of mixing, wall films and cold-start heat supply are not included; water has zero fuel heating value.

operating_map.heat_balance_scope: Design point only; no Module 03 part-load EVO sweep is available
operating_map.limitation: Fixed main/idle jets and assumed progression do not guarantee target AFR throughout the map; tune air bleed/progression on a flow bench
